node.title: Re: Getting email from fields
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Email addresses can actually get pretty complex. I recommend you use a module like [mod://Email::Address]:

use Email::Address; print $_->address,"\n" for Email::Address->parse( 'My Name email@example1.com '. 'My name '); __END__ email@example1.com email@example2.com
